releaseNotes: Seamless Gaming Experience: Intrusive system overlays and default Game Booster interruptions have been completely eliminated, ensuring a pure and immersive gaming session.
Instant HUD Deployment: The Floating Control Panel now launches flawlessly in the blink of an eye on all Android versions, requiring zero manual permission setups from the user.
Maximum Device Compatibility: Heavily optimized to run perfectly on all smartphones, including entry-level devices. Enjoy ultra-fast transitions back to your game without annoying app reloads or lag.
Bulletproof Stability: Resolved startup glitches and storage reading errors. The Neon Engine now guarantees a 100% stable and secure boot every time you tap the Quick Setting Tile.
